name: Tableau
description: Tableau is a static site generator for Elixir that renders Markdown posts through Elixir layout modules.
notes: firstRelease from the first Hex release 0.1.0 (2023-06-13). Markdown is rendered by MDEx (precompiled Rust NIF). Layouts are plain Elixir modules returning strings; Tableau also supports EEx, HEEx and Temple.
